description: This file defines the Lookup class for handling lookup operations within the PhpSpreadsheet library, including the main lookup method and helper functions for verifying and transposing lookup vectors.

classes.name: Lookup
classes.description: Provides lookup functions such as the main lookup method and internal verification helpers for lookup vectors.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Performs a lookup operation, handling array inputs and transposing vectors as needed, returning the matched value.

methods.name: verifyLookupValues
methods.description: Verifies and formats lookup vector values for consistency.

methods.name: verifyResultVector
methods.description: Ensures the result vector is correctly oriented (row or column).

methods.name: rowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows in a data array.

methods.name: columnCount
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in a data array.
